annotations.title: Send a booking, order or quote request

description: Send a booking, order or quote request to a business for the customer. Side effects: saves the request, emails the business owner (and the customer, if customer_email is given), and holds the time for bookings. Always confirm the business, time or items, and the customer's name and phone with the customer before calling. Use kind 'book' with a slot from get_available_times (plus service_id, or party_size for tables); kind 'order' with items [{offer_id, qty}] from get_business and/or details in the customer's words, and fulfilment 'pickup' or 'delivery' (delivery needs address); kind 'quote' with details. Send the kind get_business returns in 'can'. Status in the reply: 'confirmed' (the business confirms instantly), 'new' (the business confirms; check with get_request_status) or 'pending' (waiting up to 24 hours). Returns a ref and status_url; once confirmed, 'pay' says how the customer pays the business directly. Not idempotent: each call creates a new request, so do not retry a call that returned a ref; on an error, read the message, fix the input, then call again. No sign-in or API key needed. Rate limit: 600 read calls and 60 create_request calls per hour per client IP; over the limit you get error -32000 'Too many requests' (wait, then retry).

address.description: For 'order' with delivery: the full delivery address (5 characters or more).

customer_email.description: Optional but recommended: Loomivo emails the customer when the business confirms or declines.

customer_phone.description: The customer's phone, ideally with country code; the business may call or WhatsApp them.

details.description: The customer's own words: what they need (orders and quotes), or a note for a booking. Don't include health or medical details, card numbers or passwords: the business asks for anything else it needs.

fulfilment.description: For 'order': pickup at the business or delivery to address.

items.description: For 'order': products picked from get_business offers (in stock only).

qty.description: How many (not more than 'left' when given).

kind.description: What the customer wants: 'book' a time, 'order' products, or a 'quote'. Must match 'can' from get_business.

party_size.description: For 'book' at a restaurant that books tables: the number of people.

service_id.description: For 'book': the service booked (from get_business); its length decides how long the booking is.

slot.description: For 'book': the start, YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM in the business's local time, one of get_available_times.

slug.description: The business's id from search_businesses (the 'slug' field).

staff_id.description: For 'book': optional, a specific person from get_business 'staff'.
